mech.MCH-01.name: Kestrel
mech.MCH-01.summary: Rapid automatic targeting and faster weapon cycles make Kestrel the most immediately approachable chassis.
mech.MCH-02.name: Pike
mech.MCH-02.summary: A deliberate facing-based striker whose calibrated weapons hit harder across every build.
mech.MCH-03.name: Prospector

mech.MCH-04.name: Lodestar

mech.MCH-05.name: Bastion
mech.MCH-05.summary: A forgiving close-pressure platform with substantially more Hull Integrity.
mech.MCH-06.name: Razorback
mech.MCH-06.summary: A fast wedge-shaped breaker that rewards committed movement and aggressive routing.

relic.REL-01.name: Retrograde Engine
relic.REL-01.summary: All weapons attack three times as fast, but directional and targeted attacks operate on the opposite side of the mech.
relic.REL-02.name: Ghostline Chassis
relic.REL-02.summary: Your weapons deal 80% damage, but a spectral mech following 1.5 seconds behind repeats all their attacks at 60% damage.
relic.REL-03.name: Dead-Reckoning Array
relic.REL-03.summary: Weapons stop automatically aiming and instead attack along your facing direction with greatly increased damage and Area.
relic.REL-04.name: Colossus Governor
relic.REL-04.summary: Weapons attack 60% less often, but every attack deals 2.5 times the damage and becomes dramatically larger and longer-lasting.
relic.REL-05.name: War-Drum Oscillator
relic.REL-05.summary: All weapon output is stored and unleashed together every three seconds with 35% bonus power.
relic.REL-06.name: Event-Horizon Coupler
relic.REL-06.summary: Every weapon pulls enemies into its attacks, and enemies clustered together take 50% more weapon damage.
relic.REL-07.name: Fission Seed
relic.REL-07.summary: Weapons deal 35% less direct damage, but enemies they kill explode and can trigger diminishing chain reactions.
relic.REL-08.name: Redline Crucible
relic.REL-08.summary: Remaining near the same position heats and strengthens every weapon, but maximum heat burns Hull until movement vents it.
relic.REL-09.name: Claim-Jumper Core
relic.REL-09.summary: Mining is twice as fast, but all enemies move 50% faster while you are actively mining.
relic.REL-10.name: Sequential Reactor
relic.REL-10.summary: Only one weapon operates at a time, rotating every four seconds, but the active weapon receives five times its normal output.

utility.UTL-A1.name: Harmonic Calibrator
utility.UTL-A1.summary: The calibrator aligns every equipped weapon's damage output.
utility.UTL-A2.name: Survey Aperture
utility.UTL-A2.summary: The aperture extends the mech's ordinary visual and sensor discovery radius.
utility.UTL-B1.name: Reinforced Bulkhead
utility.UTL-B1.summary: The bulkhead increases maximum Hull Integrity while preserving the mech's current missing-Hull amount.
utility.UTL-B2.name: Extraction Accelerator
utility.UTL-B2.summary: The accelerator modestly increases forward mining extraction speed.
utility.UTL-C1.name: Cycle Capacitor
utility.UTL-C1.summary: The capacitor increases the activation frequency of automatic weapons.
utility.UTL-C2.name: Capacitor Screen
utility.UTL-C2.summary: The screen stores one automatic charge that negates the next incoming damage instance.
utility.UTL-D1.name: Vector Thrusters
utility.UTL-D1.summary: The thrusters permanently increase movement speed for the remainder of the run.
utility.UTL-D2.name: Extraction Tether
utility.UTL-D2.summary: The tether increases the radius within which the mech automatically mines.
utility.UTL-E1.name: Repair Swarm
utility.UTL-E1.summary: The swarm supplies continuous passive Recovery.
utility.UTL-E2.name: Priority Uplink
utility.UTL-E2.summary: The uplink coordinates all equipped weapons against elites and bosses.
utility.UTL-F1.name: Ore Catalyzer
utility.UTL-F1.summary: The catalyzer increases common basic ore obtained directly through mining.
utility.UTL-F2.name: Field Expander
utility.UTL-F2.summary: The expander increases scalable spatial dimensions of weapon attacks.
utility.UTL-R1.name: Resource radar
utility.UTL-R1.summary: The resource radar is a run-local utility blueprint intended to prevent a player from becoming completely stuck while searching for specialized ingredients needed by an intended build.
